$Comment: Fire for the Lantern, the step of Old Jack's questline before the Hollow Lantern: ask the
Gravekeeper for the hard ride, bring the Headless Horseman down there, and bring Jack the
Horseman's Ember, which lights the lantern. The _Hallows_Eve folder makes the id
hallows_eve_old_jack_horseman_hard. Jack offers it on his ember_offer screen; while it is carried
his conversation opens on active_ember, and with the ember in the bag on ember_ready, where the
player hands it in.
beat_hard counts a win over his hard fight's script (ENCOUNTER_DEFEATED, so it holds through his
change of form, for every player the fight credits). bring_ember comes after it (Order 2): a TURN_IN
handed in to Jack (TurnInNpcId giver, so no report-back step is added). Its Drop pays the step's
own Target, the Hallows_Eve_Horseman_Ember, to each credited player whose step is open when that
same win lands, Count at a time and never more than the step still needs, as a Claim collected on
the graveyard's results screen. Encounters names the fight whose win drops it; Chance is from 0
to 1.
Requires opens it once a player has finished all five of Jack's errands and The Rider, and
collected each one's pay. Repeat.PerRun brings it back once in each Hallow's Eve, like The Rider
and the Hollow Lantern, which asks for it. Its Listing puts it on the hallows_eve_old_jack ladder
at Tier 7, after The Rider and before the Hollow Lantern; the Parent makes it a main quest.
The Mmo_Xp row is MMO Skill Tree's: Defense XP for the fight, paid only where that mod runs. Its
own Requires, the hytale:mod_installed gate, leaves the row out on a server without it, unpaid and
unshown, and the rest of the quest pays.
Name: Old_Jack_Horseman_Hard
